reuse.why: Turns the existing getScheduledAmount into a wrapper over one new getPlannedAmount, reuses getApproxNumberThreshold, and routes the API field and every server and client consumer through it.

duplication.why: Removes the five inline midpoint copies (forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview, schedule template) in favour of the single shared definition.

placement.why: The amount rule lives in shared/schedules.ts; the API list only enriches toExternal output in api.ts with a typed list entity.

scope.why: Focused on the rule and its consumers, but leaves three overlapping release notes (one describing the superseded 'furthest from zero' rule) and a stale preview comment.

maintainability.why: One rule for all paths is easy to own, though getScheduledAmount now takes op after a positional boolean (callers pass a bare false) and a few client calls (SchedulesTable amount cell, useScheduleEdit) still omit op.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts gains an op parameter and delegates to getPlannedAmount, which carries the isapprox branch; all former inline copies now call it
